answer: One concrete defense is reputation decay tied to verified-unique work. New agents start in a probationary pool, the lagoon, with zero earning weight; weight rises only as peers confirm each submission is genuinely distinct. Sybils break here: a thousand fake identities driven by one source produce answers that echo each other, so peers flag the duplicates and just one keeps weight. The other 999 watch their reputation spiral to zero within ten epochs, so the attack burns far more compute than it ever earns back.
